recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, maximalist composition featuring a central female figure on an ornate throne, flanked by two stylized attendants. The image is characterized by heavy 'liquify' distortion effects that blend the subjects into a swirling background of gold, pink, and white, framed by delicate filigree and bold blackletter typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Central figure as the focal anchor amidst chaotic distortion
Contrast between sharp photographic details and fluid, melted textures
Symmetry established by flanking figures and corner filigree
Horizontal banner cutting through the verticality of the throne
coreInvariants: High-key white background with localized saturated color bleeds

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central figure seated, occupying the middle third; flanking figures scaled slightly smaller to create depth.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure's face and the bold blackletter text at the bottom right.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top-left title, follows the liquid distortion down the sides to the central figure, then across the pink banner to the bottom-right name.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Clean white space in the upper corners and edges to balance the dense, colorful center.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: White and Gold (background and throne structure)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black (typography and deep shadows in the throne)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Hot Pink and Cyan (banner and clothing highlights)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the distorted 'liquid' areas contrasting with high-value white negative space.

letterConstructionRules: High stroke contrast with vertical stress
characterSpecificRedesigns: Heavy gold outlining on the primary name text
White fill with subtle drop shadows for the banner text
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Monostylistic blackletter variations differing in scale and color treatment.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the classic fractured blackletter look
Provides the necessary ornate capital letters

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a digital collage featuring a woman with blonde hair sitting on a gold rococo throne, flanked by two figures. Apply a heavy liquid-smear distortion effect that melts the edges of the figures into a white background with swirls of pink and gold. Include a thin gold frame with ornate corner scrolls.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a translucent pink horizontal banner across the center with white blackletter text. Place large gold-outlined blackletter text in the bottom right corner and smaller blackletter text in the top left.

verificationChecks: Is the typography in a Blackletter/Gothic style?
Does the liquid distortion blend the subjects into the background?
Is there a clear central focal point?
Are the gold filigree corners present?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subjects

mustAchieve: Seamless integration of distortion and photography

postGenerationChecks: Check for clean white space at the edges
Ensure the pink banner is semi-transparent
Verify the gold outline on the main text is crisp
Confirm the liquid effect looks fluid rather than pixelated
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Rococo Throne] + [Liquid Distortion Effect] + [Blackletter Typography] + [High-Key White Background] to create a pop-maximalist aesthetic.
